before.shows: What the eye would see from orbit. Cloud is white, forest dark green, silt-laden floodwater pale brown.

after_pending: No satellite has imaged this box on the dates checked. Optical and radar passes were both tried; the next overpass may change this.

latest.shows: Radar brightness, terrain-corrected. Smooth surfaces — open water, wet sand, fresh mud — reflect away from the sensor and read DARK. Rough ground reads bright.
latest.overpass: satellite pass, either ascending or descending
